text: The GREEN Lab is a nexus between community, education and practice for the conservation, management and love of remnant native grasslands. Located at Victoria University (St Albans) beside the very special Iramoo Wildflower Grassland, we are the space of interaction for Moondani Balluk Indigenous Academic Unit, the Friends of Iramoo, the Cairnlea Conservation Reserves Committee of Management, Iramoo Native Plant Nursery, the Institute for Sustainable and Liveable Cities (VU) and the broader community. Collectively we are GREEN.
